waypoints.name: Northeast Ridge route (low point on ridge)
waypoints.directions: Take Eightmile Lake Trail #1552 about 2.8 miles to the junction past Little Eightmile Lake, go right on Trail #1554 to Lake Caroline and on toward Windy Pass, then go cross-country east onto the west end of the mountain. Below the summit pyramid, cross to the north side of the ridgeline and traverse the north-facing scree field east to the low point on the northeast ridge; early in the season this is steep snow with poor run-outs.

waypoints.name: Cashmere Mountain Summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the ridge crest straight up at the summit pyramid, mostly class 3 with a few class 4 moves, with the north face dropping away steeply behind you.
